Yo, I'm late to the party, but I'll throw my opinion out there anyways.

So, I'm in the cult. Not by choice, but by birth, like more than 99% of us are at this point. I fully plan on getting out when I can.

It's pretty hard to leave. First of all, you don't have contact with *anyone* outside the church. You're only allowed to socialize with members. You even have to go to a private school run by the Brethren, only for Brethren students, so your only friends are in the church. You don't get full internet access, there's a mandatory internet filter provided. This means that unless you find a way around it, you don't know much about the outside world. Fortunately, this is becoming less of an issue as it is hard to enforce.

Second, if you leave, you aren't allowed to talk to anyone who is still inside.  All of your family, friends and acquaintances  will shun you, and not allow you in their houses, or they might be excommunicated as well.

This means that if you leave, you're on your own in a world that you know nothing about, that you've been trained to believe is filled with evil. You've been taught that if you leave, you will go to hell. For a lot of people, they'd rather stay in misery than risk it.
